mapper.select: SELECT 'CLAIM' kind,k.value identifier,w.id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{claims} AS jsonb)) k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT id FROM work_order WHERE claim_no=k.value AND status<>'DRAFT' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2) w UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS' kind,k.value identifier,w.id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(#{businesses} AS jsonb)) k CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT id FROM work_order WHERE business_no=k.value AND status<>'DRAFT' LIMIT 2) w
